initial.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-01] Quality gate
initial.goal: Produce one fail-closed quality-gate decision for the exact converged v0.92.1 candidate.
initial.required_outcome: One exact-candidate quality-gate decision with every required proving lane passing and zero unowned exceptions.
authority_boundary: Execution starts only after #516 has a reviewed merge
The issue decides the gate but does not remediate failed lanes
Typed finish and cleanup of #516 are non-gating
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main
Reject absent, skipped, zero-test, stale, or non-proving evidence
Do not publish, merge, tag, or release
initial.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one quality-gate decision; individual proving lanes are evidence inputs.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every required proving lane passes
AC-2: Skipped, absent, zero-test, stale, and non-proving results fail closed
AC-3: The exact candidate revision and complete denominator are recorded
AC-4: Every exception has an explicit owner and no unresolved exception remains
initial.plan_summary: After #516 merges, freeze the exact candidate, enumerate every required proving lane, fail closed on non-proving evidence, and emit one quality-gate decision.

steps.action: Verify #516 reviewed-merge authority and freeze the exact candidate revision.
Build the complete required proving-lane denominator and resolve retained evidence for the exact candidate.
Classify every lane and exception, rejecting skipped, absent, zero-test, stale, or non-proving results.
Emit and validate the single exact-candidate quality-gate decision record.

invariants: No missing or non-proving lane is treated as passing
Gate evaluation does not implement remediation
risks: An incomplete denominator could create a false green
Zero-test output could be mistaken for proof
Candidate drift could stale the decision
An exception could lack an owner
stop_conditions: Any required lane fails or is absent

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove the complete required-lane denominator for the exact candidate.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned validator is an execution deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Demonstrate fail-closed handling for skipped, absent, zero-test, stale, and insufficient evidence.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned negative validator is an execution deliverable.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Bind the decision, exceptions, and artifacts to the exact candidate.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on an unmet predecessor, incomplete denominator, non-proving lane, candidate drift, or unowned exception.
review_prompts: Is the complete required-lane denominator explicit?
Can any skipped or zero-test result pass?
Is every claim bound to the exact candidate revision?
Does this issue remain a decision rather than remediation?
initial.review_scope: The exact quality-gate decision, lane denominator, fail-closed classifications, exception ownership, and retained evidence.
